problems.title: Pick the block

parts.prompt: Decouple an upload API from slow video transcoding:

problems.solution: Queues absorb slow work; object stores and CDNs serve blobs.

parts.prompt: W = 2, R = 2: do reads overlap writes?

problems.title: Consistent hashing
problems.statement: 10 nodes on a ring; add an 11th.

parts.prompt: With naive hash mod N, fraction that move (≈ 1 − 1/11)?

hints: Only keys between the new node and its predecessor move.

problems.title: Cache invalidation

parts.prompt: After writing the DB, the safer action is…
options: set the cache to the new value

hints: Races between concurrent writers and readers.
problems.solution: A delayed set can overwrite a newer value; delete-then-reload converges.

problems.title: Stampede
problems.statement: A hot key served at 50,000 reads/s expires; a DB read takes 50 ms.

parts.prompt: Requests that miss during one reload window with no coalescing?

problems.solution: 2,500 identical DB queries. Shorter TTLs make it worse.

problems.title: Delivery semantics
problems.solution: Redelivery after a crash or timeout duplicates messages.

problems.title: Hot key
problems.statement: Sharded by user id, one celebrity key gets 10⁵ reads/s.

options: replicate the key in several cache nodes

hints: More shards don't split one key.
problems.solution: Hash partitioning spreads keys, not one key's load.

problems.title: CAP
problems.statement: A network partition separates two datacentres of a bank ledger.

options: consistency: refuse writes on the minority side
availability: accept writes on both sides

problems.solution: Ledgers choose CP. A shopping cart might choose AP with merges.
